method: getComputedStyle probes on the RENDERED design (design-import/ served on :4321) vs the app on :3001. Bundle CSS was never consulted (rules/app.md).

workspaceFloatCard.note: The floating workspace panel + main card (design lines 1439, 1714).
workspaceFloatCard.verdict: EXACT. The app string additionally carries Tailwind's two inert ring placeholders (rgba(0,0,0,0) 0 0 0 0), which paint nothing.
workspaceFloatCard.foundDuringProbe: The float shadow was MISSING entirely before this probe: an arbitrary Tailwind class with multi-layer rgba() silently compiled to nothing. Replaced with the existing shadow.pane token, which is byte-identical to the design recipe. Panel width was 312 -> corrected to the probed 290.

headlineStacks.note: The design mixes TWO headline stacks and this was measured, not assumed.

supersededRecord.design: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif @ 34px / 600 (HARDCODED at design line 1269, did NOT use --head-font)
supersededRecord.flag: Reversed a design-round-2 change that put this H1 on Newsreader for app-wide consistency. Raised as a founder call rather than 'fixed' silently.

workspacePickerH1.resolution: The founder answered the call by rebuilding that headline in the DESIGN as serif (2026-08-01). The design is no longer internally inconsistent, so parity and app-wide consistency now agree.

app.remeasuredAt: 2026-08-01, after the serif call, on the shipped branch

workspacePickerH1.verdict: SERIF — matches the re-cut design and the rest of the app's headlines.
workspacePickerH1.designSideCaveat: The DESIGN side of this row was not re-probed: the 419KB source could not be re-fetched to disk this round, and present mode renders it in a cross-origin iframe, so computed styles are unreadable there. The design's serif headline was confirmed VISUALLY in present mode, not by probe.

railTextDeviation.note: tokens.harvey.railText stays #85817A (5.109:1) — the deliberate WCAG AA deviation from design round 2. NOT touched by this import.

unmappedWarmHexes.note: Five hexes the new design regions use are UNSET in the design's own [data-scheme=harvey] block (line 157), so the rendered design falls back to WARM literals there.
unmappedWarmHexes.decision: Mapped to the nearest Harvey token by ROLE rather than ported verbatim, which would have put beige onto Harvey cards (the round-2 stray-warm-hex finding). Faintest text tier became the new tokens.harvey.inkGhost #9C9C9C. Filed in agent-memory/cross-cutting.md.
